career_ladder.note: The SSC CPO examination recruits Sub-Inspectors in Delhi Police (Executive) and Sub-Inspectors (General Duty) across the Central Armed Police Forces (BSF, CRPF, CISF, ITBP, and SSB). Officers lead platoons and police stations, advancing to company/circle commands (Inspector) and entering the Group 'A' Gazetted officer cadre (Assistant Commandant / ACP) through departmental promotion committees and service examinations.

exam_scheme.note: Selection consists of four progressive stages: Paper I (Computer-Based Objective Examination, 200 marks); Physical Standard Test (PST) and Physical Endurance Test (PET) (qualifying nature); Paper II (English Language and Comprehension, 200 marks); and Detailed Medical Examination (DME). Final ranking is based on aggregate marks secured in Paper I and Paper II (400 marks total).

financial_package.note: Sub-Inspectors in Delhi Police and CAPFs are placed in Pay Level 6 (₹35,400 – ₹1,12,400) under the 7th Central Pay Commission. Delhi Police personnel receive Class 'X' metro allowances and 13-month salary compensation for extended duty hours; CAPF SIs receive Ration Money Allowance and operational Risk & Hardship Allowances in field locations.
financial_package.pay_source_label: 7th CPC Pay Matrix, Table 5 (Civilian & Police Personnel), Government of India
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated on Level 6 basic pay of ₹35,400 with 58% DA (₹20,532), HRA (10% to 30% depending on city tier; Delhi Police receives 30%), Transport Allowance (₹1,800 to ₹3,600 + DA on TA), plus Ration Money Allowance (~₹3,965/month for CAPFs) or Extra Duty Allowance (1 month extra basic pay per year for Delhi Police), minus NPS contribution.
official_perks: Ration Money Allowance (RMA) / free field mess facilities for CAPF personnel
One month extra basic pay (13-month salary benefit) for Delhi Police personnel for round-the-clock law-and-order duties
